leo2a4_v.name: Leopard 2A4 V
leo2a4_v.authority: Main ruled on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS.md, ~11:00) that the release-264 2A4-era Leopards, rebuilt on the release Leopard 2 hull with the 2A4 turret derived from our 2A6 X (owner 2026-10-28: "update and cleanup our old designs ... and have them be the before variants basically") and unregistered from their later-variant 3D oracles on 2026-10-28 (Main: "where a rebuild's registered oracle shows a different (later) variant, unregister it"), qualify the geometry stage by this per-id photographic packet plus a shaded blind photo-critic PASS (lane evidence ~/cot-lanes/leo2a4-family-264-evidence, critic rounds on the SwiftShader Gallery stills). Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified. "Leopard 2A4 V" is the fleet's name for its old build's 2A4 with the stern frame, deck stowage, standing whips and the loader's MAG, carried over row by row (lane inventory/leo2a4_v.md); it is not an official designation (Oryx's informal "2A4V" is the Ukrainian 2A4 under Kontakt-1 reactive armour, which this kit does not carry). Its figures are the baseline 2A4's. Square front, L/44.
leo2a4_v.envelopeBasis: Width is as built, 3.67 m over the fore skirt blocks; published 3.70 m including the track guards (tanks-encyclopedia) and 3.75 m (Slovak MoD). Length is the published 9.67 m gun forward of the Leopard 2A4 (Slovak MoD technical sheet; tanks-encyclopedia, de.wikipedia after Lobitz 2009; as built 9.70 m from the stern plate, which the fixture holds) plus the hull's stern rack behind the rear plate as built (0.36 m, its floor and rails; the photographs show stowage carried there). Tallest is the tips of its two standing whip antennas as built (4.24 m); the published heights are 2.48 m to the turret roof, 2.84 m to the commander's sight and 2.79 m to the PERI R 17.
